routeAdjustment: Use pinned Mathlib Ideal.Factors.piQuotientEquiv and its ramification/inertia dimensions instead of rebuilding the external conductor/fiber-ideal induction. Reuse existing integral closures, actual prime/place equivalences, order formulas, residue bijections and original field-map finiteness. A short generic CRT/norm calculation avoids repeated elaboration of the same large place instances without changing proof limits.
discharged: The actual field norm on an original modular function field evaluates to the product of actual function values over the full place fiber, with normalized ramification exponents. Native field-map finiteness and residue bijections discharge geometric premises. Fiber regularity supplies integrality; determinant base change, the pinned ramified CRT, nilpotent scalar norms and native prime/place comparisons prove the formula. Only regularity of the function on that fiber remains as the natural function condition. Divisor pullback evaluation, Weil reciprocity, pairing descent, nondegeneracy, Hecke adjointness, determinant, residual association, automorphy and all-weight continuation remain required. DUB-17--20 OPEN; 16/20.
remaining: Assemble divisor pullback evaluation and Weil reciprocity, prove representative independence and nondegeneracy, then Hecke adjointness and the Frobenius determinant.
